# Assessment Overview

This report directory contains the generated assessment report and the supplementary analysis documents copied from `.github/modernize/assessment/engines`.

## Supplementary Documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Application and component architecture diagrams with technology and responsibility summaries.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category with compatibility notes.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - HTTP surface, request patterns, and end-to-end request flow documentation.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Database, entity model, persistence, and data ownership documentation.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime profiles, and sensitive settings inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary business workflows, rules, and workflow sequence documentation.
